scripts.server-dev:web5e: PORT=3001 HOST=127.0.0.1 nodemon --watch server --ext js,json --ignore 'public/uploads/**' --ignore 'update.txt' --ignore 'apply_status.json' --ignore 'temp_diff.json' server/server.js
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others --kill-others-on-fail -n "CONDA-API,CONDAWEB,WEB5E-API,WEB5E" -c "magenta,cyan,yellow,green" "npm run server-dev" "npm run client" "npm run server-dev:web5e" "npm run client:web5e"
scripts.dev: sh -c 'for port in 3000 3001 5173 5174; do pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:$port); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill -9 $pids; fi; done; npm run dev:all'
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:web5e: npm install --prefix client-web5e && npm run build --prefix client-web5e
